authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES the FX-10 execution-mode census from permission-truth-tables.v9. v2 restores fx10Intent to the full live v9 intent and carries fx10Proves, the same truncation class as CLAUDE-FX5-SF1 / CLAUDE-FX6-SF1. It does not admit an in-host-process execution mode. It does not author a census run. It does not treat any cell as enforced in that mode. It does not execute FX-10. It does not close OBL-FX-AUTHORING. It does not SATISFY DR-105. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Continue leftover-design of OBL-FX-AUTHORING at FX-10 without admitting an in-host-process mode. v2 restores the full v9 intent so the enforced-cell-is-a-defect sentence is not dropped. The mode is not admitted here.

pttV9.fx10Intent: If an in-host-process execution mode is ever admitted, the entire corpus runs again in that mode, and the EXPECTED result is DISCLOSURE-ONLY on all seven tokens on both platforms -- including FX-3, which must FAIL to enforce, and whose failure to enforce is the passing condition. A run in that mode that reports any cell as enforced is a defect in the test, the mode, or the table.

g09v3.role: Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed. Not applied. 28-cell census is 2 platforms x 7 tokens x 2 modes; architecture axis STATED INVARIANT. This catalog does not re-author that census and does not admit a third in-host-process mode.
